## Why / 변경 이유

What concrete problem does this solve?

## What changes / 변경 내용

Explain the resulting behavior. Add screenshots for visual changes when helpful.

## Verification / 검증

List commands actually run, outcomes and any manual checks. Explain unrun checks and platform limits.

## Risks and follow-up

Mention schema, export, accessibility or Electron security implications where relevant.

## Contributor checks

- [ ] Changes follow the visual-only, local-first product contract.
- [ ] No credentials, personal projects or unlicensed assets are included.
- [ ] Commits are small, published individually and use an English prefix with a Korean message.
- [ ] Branch names follow `chatgpt/` namespaces; merge will preserve two parents.
- [ ] No GitHub Actions workflow was added or run.
